result.stdout:
USAGE:
    escape [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    sub        Manage subscriptions                                             
    node       Manage subscription nodes                                        
    connect    Probe, choose and start a node                                   
    status     Show whether a CLI proxy session is currently running            
    stop       Stop the active CLI proxy                                        
    rules      Manage custom domain rules. Example: escape rule add google.com, 
               escape rule add openai.com -no                                   
    config     Manage CLI configuration
